decisions.reason: The margin analysis draws on the firm's core market-data assets and fits the announced platform strategy, and after two years of public presentation management still treats slow uptake as ramp-up rather than failure.
The gas tariff comparison runs on existing maintained databases at low marginal cost and remains publicly presented, so with sunk investment and a visible commitment management persists.

The electricity tariff calculator is core-adjacent and strengthens the central platform, and since the overlapping regional calculator D has already been withdrawn, C has become the retained offering in that space.

The area definition tool supports the remaining location-based products and the platform, so dropping it would undercut earlier commitments, although the withdrawals of D and F slightly weaken its role.
